page.overview:
Who is Shana Goridien?

Shana Goridien is an Aes Sedai of the White Ajah.

She has bulging eyes and reminds Elayne of a fish. She always looks startled, although she normally maintains a deep reserve.

Shana is very weak for an Aes Sedai, with a strength in the One Power of . We know of only a handful of Aes Sedai that are weaker. She matches Siuan Sanche's strength level after she was Healed for her stilling.

Although weak in the One Power, she is an expert at reading residues.
